svg.aria-label: Career, as a git log. Aug 2026 → now: Intern AI Engineer, ADDLYFT. Voice and video generation for in-store retail ads. Built the voice-ad service (Gemini, ElevenLabs, FFmpeg) in Python, then rebuilt it in NestJS. Benchmarked video models and cut per-shot generation from 697 s to 116 s. Apr → May 2026: Software Consultant, Indian Navy. Built StockFlow, an inventory and order-tracking web app. Feb → Aug 2026: AI Developer (freelance), CStoreExpert. Retail computer vision and audio ads for a US convenience-store client: YOLOv8 shelf counting, an LLM gateway over nine providers, and the AddX app. 2024 → 2027: B.Tech, AI & ML, St. John College of Engineering and Management. University of Mumbai · final year Feb → Aug 2024: Web Development Intern (backend), Tenet Concepts / Worko. Serverless TypeScript API on AWS Lambda and DynamoDB: payments, WhatsApp Cloud API, SQS and EventBridge schedules. Top committer on the API. 2022 → 2024: Diploma, Computer Engineering, Government Polytechnic Mumbai.
